name: Redeeming Codes
summary: Free boosts and cash, while they last.

sections.heading: How to redeem
sections.body: Settings cogwheel (top of the screen) → **Codes** tab → *ENTER CODE* box → **Redeem**. Codes are case-sensitive.

sections.heading: A warning
sections.body: Codes expire without warning. Each one below shows the date it was last checked. Try them, but don't count on them.
